engineering_promotion.caveat: Engineering source integration is not scientific admission or runtime deployment

index_scope: Every Git-tracked JSON or JSONL under data/evidence/dashboard/docs/figures/bench; identities only, not source contents
inventory_merkle_recipe: SHA256('FF_GOV_LEAF_V1'+NUL+sorted canonical JSON+LF); SHA256('FF_GOV_NODE_V1'+NUL+raw left+raw right); odd carry

judge_workstreams.name: Synthea cohort, form server, oracle
judge_workstreams.source_note: 100 patients, splits 63/19/18, byte-reproducible. Two oracle rules still need PI sign-off (T02).

judge_workstreams.name: B0 baseline (frozen rule filler)
judge_workstreams.source_note: 33.3% full-form success (18/54) on the held-out test split.

judge_workstreams.name: FCG harness L1-L3 + LOMO
judge_workstreams.source_note: 0.333 -> 0.556 (12/0 discordant, p=0.00049). Discovery grade: modules written after B0 errors were seen (T01).

judge_workstreams.name: Injected-error detectors M1-M3
judge_workstreams.source_note: Preregistered: 654 forms, 702 injected errors. M3 source binding recall 0.99; LOMO: removing M3 loses 0.563 recall (p=2.5e-119), while M1 and M2 add nothing once M3 is present.

judge_workstreams.name: Admission-gate factorial (SYNFORM2-ERR)
judge_workstreams.source_note: Per-field commitment leaf: detection 0.13 -> 1.00, 0 false admissions. Replication NOT_TESTED.

judge_workstreams.name: Fault-injection factorial, 16 arms
judge_workstreams.source_note: Seeded faults with known corrections; 100% repair is by design, not a model gain.

judge_workstreams.name: OCR arms: Tesseract, Apple Vision/PDFKit
judge_workstreams.source_note: Tesseract labels 0.967 / values 0.787. Apple A2 read-back loses dropdowns and long lists (p=0.5).

judge_workstreams.name: VLM qwen2.5vl:3b boxes + injection
judge_workstreams.source_note: Box recall 0.821, value read 0.736, 24 s/page. Injection followed 0/18 (V1i on open PR #29).

judge_workstreams.name: Trained box validators (#14 #15 #16)
judge_workstreams.source_note: No gain over deterministic contour control. D2 recall 0.956 / precision 0.656 is exploratory; no new-layout test.

judge_workstreams.name: V2 YOLOv8n detector + OCR value check
judge_workstreams.source_note: Pipeline merged; run in progress on MacBookPro (T09).

judge_workstreams.name: Qwen text mappers on OCR lines
judge_workstreams.source_note: Both Qwen mappers below the deterministic parser on identical input (209 and 109 vs 283 of 322 fields).

judge_workstreams.name: Post-training arm M0 / M1 SFT / M2
judge_workstreams.source_note: Qwen2.5-0.5B LoRA: one epoch-0 val loss (1.005), no adapter saved. Restart on MacBookPro.

judge_workstreams.name: Custody: Merkle, Lean 4, red-team replay
judge_workstreams.source_note: All roots recomputed independently; 7 custody weaknesses reproduced as tests; forged-custody fix (#8).

judge_workstreams.name: CI, gitleaks, JSON-only publication gate
judge_workstreams.source_note: Full-history gitleaks; 123 legacy files pinned by exact blob; new images under data/evidence/experiments rejected.

judge_workstreams.name: Prompt-injection filter
judge_workstreams.source_note: Measured (V1i, Tesseract reads the note in 19/57) but no filter exists.

judge_workstreams.name: Noisy / scanned renders
judge_workstreams.source_note: All arms read clean browser renders.

judge_workstreams.name: Cost / latency per correct form
judge_workstreams.source_note: Per-page latency recorded for some arms; no seconds-per-correct-form metric.

judge_workstreams.name: Fresh replication cohort
judge_workstreams.source_note: Needs a preregistered new Synthea seed scored once with frozen arms.

limits: Historical derived records only; no model inference or new clinical claim
No FHIR patient content, raw PDF, image or weight binaries copied
Source main can advance, requiring a successor ledger
DAISY method abstract only; NOT_COMPUTED is not a zero-value observation
